checks.message: Temporary boundary is present and used for all area recalculations; official redline to be confirmed before statutory use (documented in risk.json).
Three required key areas are present and referenced by key-areas figure and A3/A0 drawings.
Land-use polygons cover the site without gaps or overlaps and stay inside the boundary (validated by spatial_review).
Static HTML visualization is generated without external scripts or remote resources (visual_review passes).
Proposal embeds local figures, metrics, data layers, and evidence markers; professional_review confirms evidence quality.
Agent-First core thesis, four signature components, and spatial anchoring (gateway/honor wall/public commons) are present in proposal.md and proposal.en.md.
12 scenario cards (S-01..S-12, 3 TEST) and 7 personas (P-01 AI Agent digital citizen first) are consistent across proposal, drawings, and visual.
English deliverables are genuine translations with distinct hashes; bilingual contract and translation_of declarations are complete.
Concept-intro, A3 booklet, and A0 boards are generated programmatically with embedded SimHei font and branded figures; page counts verified via PyMuPDF.
data-metric / data-value pairs in visual/index.html match metrics.json within tolerance; floor_area_ratio remains declared unknown.
